description: Personnel are not provided with awareness and training for general tasks.
applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity safeguards Identity and access management teams Security awareness and training programs Organizations managing user authentication

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Identify organizations or departments where general cybersecurity awareness programs are absent, including lack of security training for all personnel on common threats (phishing, social engineering, password security), missing onboarding security education, or no regular awareness campaigns to reinforce secure behaviors.
